text.text: We have used Accurate many times over the years and have received nothing less than amazing service! We always recommend them when we see someone looking.

Great experience with Accurate Plumbing. Kameron was quick, friendly, and knowledgeable. He noticed our sump pump wasn’t working, which could’ve turned into a big problem.

He had a new sump pump installed in under 30 minutes and also checked our low water pressure and gave some helpful recommendations. Very professional company. Highly recommend.

text.text: Mike and his team at Accurate Plumbing do an exceptional job of diagnosing plumbing problems and fixing them efficiently. They are very professional, knowledgeable and ethical. In addition, their service is very reasonably priced. I was very impressed with Joe who was recently at our house to fix a difficult bathroom leak. Not only did he identify the issue but he did a great job in fixing it and gave me some excellent suggestions for insuring less problems in the future. This is a great company!

text.text:
This company is aces. Accurate Plumbing is our go-to company and first on our call list when we need plumbing-related services. We have found them reliable, competent, professional, courteous, reasonably priced, and an all around pleasure with which to do business. We believe in supporting small businesses and appreciate this family-run company.

July 28, 2020 Installed a new 50-gallon hot water tank for us. The process of removing the old and installing the new tank went seamlessly. Shout out to Justin and Logan!
November 6, 2025 Replaced a 24-year old toilet wax seal in our Master bath after discovering a water leak in the ceiling below. We couldn't have asked for a service call to go more pleasantly or smoothly. Shout out to Kameron!
November 17, 2025 Proactively replaced a 24-year old toilet wax seal in our upstairs hall bath. Replaced our builder-grade, plastic push/pull water lines and valves with new, upgraded hot and cold water braided lines and metal valves under a bathroom and a kitchen sink.  Another top-notch experience. Shout out to Joe and Kameron!
January 5, 2026 Installed a new tub valve, new shut-off valves, and a new trim kit for our Roman tub. Top-notch work. Replaced old, stuck shut off valves with new and installed a new faucet in the bathroom. Avoided unnecessary work with a tricky hot water line under the sink. Shout out to Bill and Kameron!
January 21, 2026 Installed a new sump pump, new check valves for both the main and auxilliary pumps, and new PVC pipe. Couldn't have asked for a smoother service call. So grateful for this company. Thanks, Kameron!
